response.overview: Independent filmmaker Chaea is about to get married and wants to let go of her old dreams and the relationships she’s held onto for years. But when her high school friends throw her a surprise bridal shower, the happy moment quickly changes. What starts as friendly talk turns into quiet competition and old feelings coming back. A party game meant to lighten the mood leads to unexpected truths, and soon the whole party falls apart. Left alone, Chaea looks at the broken friendships and feels empty — but she decides to turn the experience into a film. By doing so, she lets go of her past and chooses to start again through cinema.
response.title: Here’s Looking at You, My Dear
